description: Land Acquisition - Unella, Palatuwa and Aththudwa, Elambakalagoda, Thihagoda D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
